(Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and positioned to preferentially direct light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body__.
